sections.chapter_title: Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)
sections.section_title: FDCAN TT cycle time and count register (FDCAN_TTCTC)
sections.text_helper: Section 71.6.15 "FDCAN TT cycle time and count register (FDCAN_TTCTC)" in chapter 71 (Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3737.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x0138
Reset value: 0x003F 0000
Bits 31:22 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 21:16 CC[5:0]: Cycle count
0x00 to 3F Number of actual basic cycle in the system matrix
Bits 15:0 CT[15:0]: Cycle time
Non-fractional part of the difference of the node local time and Ref_Mark (see Section71.4.13).
0x0000 to FFFF: cycle time value of FDCAN basic cycle
